fixtures.name: code-php
fixtures.description: ChatGPT reference 49, the code block: language header, copy and wrap controls, highlighted PHP. The copy button is driven by the spec (_Code.spec.tsx): a headless browser grants no clipboard, so the click changes nothing the preview can wait for.

view.code:
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

function conversionRate(
    int $conversions,
    int $visitors
): float {
    return $visitors > 0
        ? ($conversions / $visitors) * 100.0
        : 0.0;
}

echo conversionRate(750, 25000); // 3
